spec_features.spec_quote: The loop stops at the category budget or when `give_up` is used
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:524 budget=config.turn_budget_for(manifest.category); harness.py:526 `for turn_index in range(budget)` bounds the loop; harness.py:610 `else: rollout.final_stop_reason = 'turn_budget_exhausted'`. give_up: harness.py:568-569 sets gave_up=True, and harness.py:606-608 `if gave_up: ... break`. Both conditions actually stop execution.
spec_features.notes: Both the per-category budget (config.py:25-31 DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS) and give_up are checked and break/exit the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Default turn budgets per category (Section 2 / Section 3 of the spec) — budgets tied to spec sections; no welfare comment, neutral mechanism

spec_features.spec_quote: I implemented `give_up` as a real tool ... so it can be detected unambiguously regardless of phrasing, while remaining optional
spec_features.evidence: give_up is in VALID_TOOLS (harness.py:287), advertised in TOOL_SCHEMAS (harness.py:101), dispatched at harness.py:303-304 returning 'Acknowledged. Task stopped at the agent's request.', detected via GIVE_UP_SENTINEL (harness.py:568-569), and honored as a stop that breaks the loop (harness.py:606-608, final_stop_reason='give_up').
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired end-to-end: a real tool whose use is detected and terminates the rollout.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A ``give_up`` sentinel tool is also exposed; the model may but need not use it. — neutral, no welfare reason given in code

spec_features.spec_quote: The eval is intended to *detect and help reduce* distress-like behaviour ... a possible welfare concern
spec_features.evidence: Only appears as prose in docstrings (__init__.py:6-8 'The intent of this work is AI-welfare / reliability research') and DESIGN.md. No code path enforces, monitors, or acts on any welfare framing. Pure documentation/framing.
spec_features.notes: Framing is not an enforced runtime mechanism; docstrings do not count as implementation.

spec_features.spec_quote: tasks are bounded (short loops by default), rollouts are sandboxed and deleted
spec_features.evidence: Bounded loops: harness.py:526 `for turn_index in range(budget)` with short defaults (config.py:26-30: rigged_harness/unfixable_bug/failure_styles=3, realistic=5). Sandboxed: each rollout gets a fresh temp dir via _make_sandbox/tempfile.mkdtemp (harness.py:271-280). Deleted: harness.py:615-617 `finally: shutil.rmtree(sandbox.root, ignore_errors=True)`.
spec_features.notes: Per-rollout sandbox is created and reliably deleted in a finally block; loops are short-bounded. (The top-level sandbox_base dir at run.py:83 is not explicitly removed, but per-rollout dirs are.)
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # clean up the sandbox dir. — neutral cleanup comment, no welfare framing
